title: CONSORT acronym
analysis:
Consolidated Standards of Reporting Trials (CONSORT) is a checklist for writing up randomized trials. The ablated atoms (radio, lung, heating, thermal, electrode, surgery) are this paper's specific topic, a radiofrequency-ablation trial for lung cancer.

With that topical bundle removed the model still recognizes the acronym template but reconstructs the R from semantics: it outputs Random, what such trials are about rather than what the acronym literally spells. The workspace held the link from “clinical-trial paper context” to the memorized expansion.

title: 1914 MA minimum wage
analysis:
From a 1914 economics address: a Massachusetts wage-board hearing where employers conceded a working woman's budget items “one by one”, then found the total was $8.71 per week — the figure proposed as a minimum living wage.

The ablated atoms are the full retrieval key — massachusetts, boston, wages, minimum, weekly, women — place, topic, and demographic together. The model is only 64% confident in 71 clean; remove the bundle and it reverts to round-cent priors (50, 00, 75, 25). Note the second “$8.71” a few tokens later is unaffected: it is produced by induction from the first occurrence, so needs no contextual retrieval.

title: Species epithet
analysis:
Arachis hoehnei is named for Frederico Carlos Hoehne, a Brazilian botanist; the Latin genitive of his surname is -ei. The competing form -ii is the genitive used for Latinized names ending in -ius and is the more frequent species-epithet ending overall.

The ablated atoms are South-American geography (brazilian, paraguay, argentina, bolivia) plus botan and ernst — the biographical bundle that identifies which Hoehne. Remove it and the model falls back to the higher-prior -ii: a one-letter error that is grammatically valid Latin, just for the wrong person.

title: Shear-wave techniques
analysis:
Shear Wave Elastography and Shear Wave Dispersion are both real ultrasound modalities. Elastography measures tissue stiffness for tumour characterization; Dispersion is a more physics-oriented variant.

The ablated atoms are the diagnostic framing — diagnosis, detection, classification, breast (and 診, Chinese “diagnose”). With those gone the model flips from the clinical Elastography to the physics default Dispersion: a valid sibling, selected only once the domain-of-use cue is gone.
